title: Airline baggage liability - federal basics
facts: For domestic U.S. air travel, DOT sets a minimum maximum-liability requirement for lost, damaged or delayed baggage that airlines cannot set below the federal amount.
The domestic baggage-liability limit is periodically adjusted for inflation, so the current dollar figure should be verified before quoting an amount.
International baggage claims can be governed by international treaties and use different liability rules.
Airlines may exclude certain categories of items from liability where permitted, subject to applicable law and their contract of carriage.
